summary: 90 holdings; the top ten are 36% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 120% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 1.7 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced, more profitable and much larger.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 5 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in Norway in 1961; led a Norwegian navy special forces unit, then studied at Williams College and Stanford. Director of equities at Tiger Management, then co-founded Viking Global in 1999 with David Ott and Brian Olson.
profile.approach: Fundamental stock-picking across sectors, long and short.
